items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh Wycliffe Gordon. [INTERVIEWEE] Wycliffe. So there are those.

ctx.x: Yeah. And there are a few. I guess it’s the Uncle Tom thing. A lot of them just associate that music with the old days when Teddy Wilson couldn’t find a hotel because he was black or something like that. And I don’t know who’s — I guess family-wise and friend- wise they’re cultivating that. They’re keeping that going faster than we’re getting them to play in parties and groups you know. I had a call — in my career in Orlando, which is kind of waning, I mean there’s not much going on, you know I used to book some…

Wycliffe. So there are those. And I remember I was with Wild Bill Davison’s, I mean I never played with so many hotshot musicians in my life as the old Norway ship jazz parties with Hank and Shelly used to book the musicians.
